subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Frisky
solution:
The correct answer is: Playful.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Frisky"** means lively, playful, and full of energy. (चंचल)

 
 
• **Example: **The **frisky **puppy ran around the garden, chasing its tail.
 
 
 
• **"Playful"** refers to someone or something full of fun and high spirits, often engaging in light-hearted activities. (खिलंदड़)
 
 
• **Example: **The **playful** children spent the afternoon playing games in the park.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Frisky'** is **'Playful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Memorable** (स्मरणीय): Worth remembering or easily remembered, especially because of being special or unusual.

 
 
• **Example:** Our trip to the mountains was a **memorable **experience.
 
 
 
• **Loose** (ढीला): Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.
 
 
• **Example:** The **loose **button on his shirt finally fell off.
 
 
 
• **Transient** (क्षणिक): Lasting only for a short time; impermanent.
 
 
• **Example:** The **transient **nature of life teaches us to cherish every moment.
